spot.html_text: Gentle-strength paraconsistency is simply the rejection of explosion with respect to logical consequence. Full-strength paraconsistency has it that there are interesting or important theories that are inconsistent but not trivial. Industrial-strength paraconsistency has it that some inconsistent but non-trivial theories are possibly true. Dialetheic paraconsistency has it that some inconsistent but non-trivial theories are true.
